agent_comments:
This is a feature request for a new column, so it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue can be considered, as the feature template describes.

Rich already has a few ways to show speed. [`TaskProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) takes `show_speed=True` for tasks without a total, and [`TransferSpeedColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) covers bytes. Neither takes a custom unit. Subclassing `ProgressColumn` is the way to get `rows/s` or `req/s` today.
